text:
Lina S.: Heads up — intermittent Edit button is appearing for users with only the 'viewer' role after this morning's KMS key rotation. Seeing at least 2 reports. @Alice @Sam can you take a quick look?

Alice F.: Saw one from a customer repro. Screenshot attached in case. Project overview shows Edit enabled for viewer. Steps: login -> Projects -> click Project X -> Edit button present. :eyes:

Alice F.: Quick check from client console: `auth.checkPermissions()` returns `{"allowed": false, "missing": ["projects.edit"]}` but UI still renders edit control.

Sam I.: We rotated the KMS key at 03:14 UTC and rolled secrets through the pipeline. Vault audit shows `rotate_key success` around that time. No role migration jobs ran, AFAIK.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: console@v2.3.7 -> prod (2026-03-19T03:20:00Z)

Kevin R.: Could be a client-side cache/local override issue. Our auth flags TTL is 15m; if localStorage persisted a shim it might survive key swap. Also check edge CDN if we serve any precomputed view model.

Lina S.: I searched audit logs for UI overrides: found `console.ui_permission_override` events at 03:16 for the same accounts. Backend denies the action, so no write happened, but UI shows the affordance.

Alice F.: digging into frontend code. There's a merge path `getUiFlags()` that does `const flags = { ...serverFlags, ...localOverride };` — localOverride comes from `localStorage.perm_shim`. If localOverride was set earlier, it will re-enable the button even if serverFlags say no. PR incoming to make serverFlags authoritative.

Maria P.: This is a customer-facing UX vulnerability even if no backend escalation. We should: 1) hide dangerous affordances until server confirmation, 2) invalidate any client-side overrides post-KMS rotation, and 3) notify support with a brief status.

Lina S.: Proposed immediate mitigations: 
1) Hotfix to hide Edit/save buttons unless server confirms permission (frontend toggle).
2) Purge `localStorage.perm_shim` on next load via versioned key bump.
3) Run an audit query to enumerate accounts that saw `ui_permission_override`.

Alice F.: PR `fix/ui-perm-gating-atomic` opened. Changes: UI waits on `auth.checkPermissions()` result before rendering edit affordance and removes local override merge. Adding unit tests. Rolling canary to 10% now.

Sam I.: I'll schedule a job to push a small JS snippet that clears `localStorage.perm_shim_v*` on client startup and to add a one-off backend migration to mark overrides invalid. Also correlating KMS rotation id with affected sessions.

Kevin R.: Ran audit query: `SELECT user_id FROM audit_events WHERE event = 'console.ui_permission_override' AND ts > '2026-03-19T03:00:00Z'` -> 7 unique user_ids (internal + 4 customers). Exporting list to /tmp/perm_override_20260319.csv and attaching to this thread.

support-bot: Created ticket INC-9082 and routed to support-team; included preliminary note: 'UI showed edit controls to viewer role; no backend writes observed. Investigating.'

Maria P.: I'll draft a short message for affected customers and run it by legal/comms. Proposed wording emphasizes no data change and steps we took.

Lina S.: Owner assignments: Alice -> frontend fix + release, Sam -> purge overrides + KMS correlation, Kevin -> final audit + CSV, Maria -> support comms. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if we confirm root cause.

Alice F.: :thumbsup: PR merged to canary. ETA full rollout 30m if no regressions.

Sam I.: Note: we rolled the KMS key rollback test at 04:05 (rolled back to previous key for validation). No backend role-change events after rollback.

Lina S.: Thanks all. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes and the CSV export. If anyone finds evidence of a backend permission grant, ping me immediately. :white_check_mark:
